summary: Contestants demonstrate entry-level word processing skills by creating, editing, and formatting business documents. The event is for secondary or postsecondary students with one year or less of word processing experience who are not enrolled in a second year. All work is completed on-site and uploaded electronically.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
submission_requirements: All contestant-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Apply foundational formatting skills using modern word processing tools to create business documents
Demonstrate entry-level word processing using standard word processing tools
Use editing tools to revise, proofread, and enhance the clarity and accuracy of business documents
Apply paragraph formatting, tab settings and text enhancements to improve document structure and visual impact
eligibility_notes: Only secondary or postsecondary division contestants who have completed one year (or less) of word processing and are not enrolled in the second year may enter this application event.
Contestants who have previously competed in Fundamental, Intermediate, or Advanced Word Processing cannot enter this event.
Contestants may participate in only one of these events each year.
